name: Partner Robotics PavePal P900
summary: Battery-powered wheeled robot with one arm that spreads tile adhesive and lays floor tiles up to 600 × 1200 mm, one lane at a time, at up to 18 m² per hour.

germany.statusNote: Sold direct from Dongguan, China, on request (form or email; German-language website). The maker reports use in Berlin (APCOA project, April 2026) and a demonstration in France, says the robot meets CE requirements and quotes EU delivery of 1–3 units 2 weeks after order. No EU dealer or service centre yet: local support only in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Hong Kong and Taiwan, physical repairs need a technician flown in from China, and EU risk-assessment documents are not yet available. No public price.
germany.leadTime: 1–3 units: 2 weeks after order confirmation; 4 or more: 35–40 days (maker FAQ, for the EU)

sellers.name: Partner Robotics Co., Ltd.
sellers.note: Dongguan, Guangdong, China. Contact form on the product page; on-site demo projects and operator training offered. German-language site: de.partnerrobotics.com.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: net; gross weight up to 880 kg

specs.label: Payload (tile)
specs.conditions: per tile; FAQ says up to 35 kg per tile, homogeneous tiles under 30 kg

specs.label: Laying rate
specs.conditions: maximum; FAQ: about 14 m²/h with 600 × 600 mm and 18 m²/h with 800 × 800 mm tiles, site dependent

specs.label: Battery
specs.conditions: Li-ion, replaceable in a few minutes (FAQ); voltage not stated

specs.label: Charging supply
specs.conditions: FAQ: charging works on 230 V EU site power

specs.label: Floor flatness needed
specs.conditions: screed required, not a raw slab

specs.label: Crew
specs.conditions: for full output: 1 operator, 1 worker for fine-tuning and clips, 1 for tile and mortar supply; 1–2 possible at lower output

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: cameras with AI for tile alignment, laser reference for the adhesive level, safety lidar

notes: Lays full tiles only: cut pieces at the edges and leveling clips are done by hand.
Needs screed with about ±5 mm flatness; cannot climb stairs; does not avoid obstacles by itself (operator steers it remotely).
Operator sets tile size and lanes on a tablet; the robot lays one lane, then switches lanes manually or automatically.
Cannot compensate warped tiles; keeps the adhesive surface level with a laser reference (adhesive up to about 1.5 cm thick).
Patterns: the FAQ says straight and offset (brick) bond; the demo page says staggered patterns are not supported in demos.
Standard bundle: control tablet, battery, tile loading trolley, mixer ('Stirring Pal') and bucket lift ('Bucket Lift Pal').
